changes_made.explanation: Consolidated model variants to base model names (e.g., Flan-T5 instead of individual sizes), removed duplicate output descriptions, and normalized model names to standard forms

No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The LLMs mentioned (GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-4) were used as baseline generation models, not as evaluators.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on extractive machine reading comprehension using generative models. It evaluates generated answers using automatic metrics but does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and consolidation of metric variants.
